Confirm it's you

Some admin actions ask for your password a second time, even though you're already signed in.

Why you're seeing this

A session cookie proves who opened this browser, not who is at it now. Creating a user, resetting another user's password and granting admin rights each hand out access that keeps working after you sign out, so they ask for a second confirmation before they run.

Actions that remove access — disabling, demoting, deleting — never ask, so you can always shut an account down in a hurry.

This is your same password again, not a second factor. Confirming lasts 15m, and ends when you sign out.
